    Verification

    Age, ID and driver's license checks needed before booking.

    Checking your verification...

    Open verification

    Account verification

    Verify your account

    Hotel bookings need your age and an approved ID. Parking reservations, including a parking add-on, also need a driver's license.

    This is a demonstration. NEXORA is a student project with no identity verification provider. It never asks for photos of your documents or your full ID number, and these checks do not prove who anyone is.

    How NEXORA handles this information

    What is kept
    Your date of birth; your ID type, the last 4 characters of its number and its expiry date; NEXORA's decision and any note; a history of these steps. Never document photos, full ID numbers, selfies or other biometrics.
    Why
    Only to check that you are 18 or over and that your account has an approved ID before booking, and that parking customers have a driver's license.
    Who can see it
    You, and NEXORA administrators who review it. Nobody can approve their own verification, and you cannot change your own status.
    How long
    ID digits and expiry dates on rejected or replaced submissions are erased 30 days after review. The rest is kept while your account exists.
    Your rights
    You can ask to see, correct or delete this information. See the Privacy Policy for how to ask.

    NEXORA hotel demo

    Explore the hotel in 3D. Select Enter hotel to begin; use W A S D to walk, your mouse to look around, and E or click to interact. On touch screens, use the on-screen controls. Room and parking reservations sync from the database every 20 seconds; reserve through the booking pages.

    Help and support

    Service status and recovery

    Check whether the booking service is responding. This does not expose internal system logs.

    Service status has not been checked yet.

    If something goes wrong
    1. Check service status, then retry when the service is responding.
    2. For a failed booking, check My bookings before submitting again to avoid duplicates.
    3. If your session expired, return to sign in and log back in; your account and saved bookings are stored on the service.
    4. If the issue continues, send a report below. Do not include passwords or payment-card details.

    Report a problem

    Your report is saved for the NEXORA administrators and emailed to the hotel when email delivery is configured. A recent failed request reference is attached when available.

    How do I cancel a booking?

    Open My bookings, choose Manage, then cancel the reservation. You can cancel while its status is Pending, Processing, or Approved.

    When am I charged?

    No payment is collected when you submit a reservation. Requests are approved automatically when a room or parking space is available; otherwise, staff can review them. Cash and bank transfer are payment preferences only. This app does not process payments.

    How do I get into a car park?

    After your reservation is approved, open its active QR pass from My bookings and present it to facility staff for verification. Automated gate access is not integrated.
